content: Bubbletea TUI pitfalls: (1) Blocking Update() with I/O freezes TUI — wrap all I/O in tea.Cmd. (2) Raw goroutines that mutate model state cause data races — use tea.Cmd exclusively. (3) Message ordering from concurrent commands is non-deterministic — never assume order. (4) tea.Quit is non-deterministic in the command tumbler; input can arrive after quit is queued. (5) Multi-pane focus: handle tea.BlurMsg/tea.FocusMsg; tmux needs explicit configuration for focus events. (6) Keep root model lean — only UI state, not cached data or auth state. (7) Hard-coded widget heights break on border/padding changes — use lipgloss.Height() dynamically. (8) Debug by logging to file, not stdout.
